purpose: Conditional measurement repeatability and readout diagnostics, not independent predictive evidence or an irreducible error bound

assignment.default_unit: Complete eligible captured cell, including zero-RNA cells
assignment.alternate_unit: A declared capture unit only with a separate exact provenance binding; never infer units from a donor alias or arbitrary partition
assignment.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical JSON [frontier-reliability-v1, population_identity, repetition, unit_id]; rank hash then unit_id; first floor(unit_count/2) units in A, remaining units in B
assignment.balance: Across the whole population's splitting units, never separately within guides or controls
assignment.paired_channels: Reuse the same assignment for captured counts and positive-RNA state/molecular summaries
assignment.repeatability: Order-invariant, disjoint, exhaustive; repetitions overlap and are not independent replicates
assignment.capture_units: Unit counts are balanced, not necessarily cell counts; disjointness does not prove independent errors

readouts.catalog: Every category retained in each half, including observed zeros; separate both empirical directional cross-entropies and quadratic scores
readouts.empirical_zero_forecast: Positive observed mass against zero empirical forecast is explicitly positive infinity, never silently floored
readouts.molecular: Equal positive-RNA-cell mean composition within guide; pooled NTC is equal over all positive-RNA NTC cells in that half; transform only after pooling
readouts.state: Existing energy, pairwise spread and fixed multiscale MMD2 on the exact subset-native representation, with full supplied half support
readouts.joint: Only matched state/count half populations may form a joint diagnostic; no separate per-guide balancing
readouts.missing_half_support: Unavailable state/RNA channel with explicit half-support count; retain complete catalog and any independently available endpoint
readouts.tier_axis: Explicit supplied source support count, not selected from favorable endpoint or model scores

cross_error.unbiased_noise_removal_requires: Unbiased independent half-estimation errors for one estimand, also independent of the forecast; these are not established by disjoint cell IDs
cross_error.nonlinear_transform: log1p(10000*mean_composition) need not be an unbiased endpoint estimator
cross_error.conditional_partition: Random halves of a fixed observed population have dependent sampling errors; do not call their cross-error a conditional noise-corrected forecasting risk
cross_error.shared_controls: The same half-specific control enters every contrast; retain one control observation per split population, not one independent control per target

custody.before_outer_release: Only explicitly admitted fitting-donor observations may be analyzed; no outer truth or outer-derived calibration
custody.after_outer_release: Outer diagnostics are descriptive assessment companions only, with the same frozen forecast release as the main assessment

remaining_bindings: Exact populations, row/unit identities, fitting or released-assessment roles and input leases
Total repetitions times eligible populations, state-pair and gene-block operation counts
Actual resource, output and retention limits; approved scientific worker and publication path
